purpose: Bounded transfer audit of one fixed high-precision COVTrack score gate followed by the already fixed causal one-frame physical reassociation; not formal frontend qualification or training.

source.source_selection: Read only the already completed anonymous physical streams; no frontend inference or duplicate full cache.

development_pseudo.selection_rule: Reuse the previously frozen first eight development_pseudo role IDs; no outcome or GT selection.

policy_train_pseudo.selection_rule: Reuse the previously frozen ten policy_train_pseudo role IDs; no outcome or GT selection.

fixed_mechanism.score_threshold_rationale: The already registered full-407 counterfactual cut in covtrack_score_gate_full_train_v1; no new threshold sweep.
fixed_mechanism.reassociation_rule: At each source frame, one-to-one Hungarian IoU bridge from a current birth to at most one prior persistent state; no future observations.
fixed_mechanism.candidate_order: causal score gate first, then one-frame physical reassociation

evaluation.continuity: adjacent sealed geometry-only GT observations with same candidate IDs
